notes: Summary: Programmatic adtech platform building a real-time bidder and personalization layer. Extremely latency- and cost-sensitive: target p95 <= 18ms for inference path, throughput up to 5k rps during peak auctions.

Use-case specifics: primary workload = reranking + short-form generation (subject lines, ad copy variants) + embeddings for user-profile matching. Expect mixed request sizes; median context ~80 tokens, tail to 512 tokens for longer personalization contexts.
Performance ask (from CTO Tara Malik): 'We need predictable ms-level tail latency and consistent unit cost under bursty auction load. If batching helps, show real cost delta and SLO impact.'

Optimize interest: high. Customers want recommendations for batching thresholds (latency vs cost tradeoffs), automatic prefix/KV caching for repeated user contexts, and quantization options for lower-cost variants. Also interested in Redwood Optimize tooling to surface model/quantization profiles by workload.

Security/compliance: must live in VPC for production. SOC2 + SSO (SAML) mandatory. KMS integration required for key material and audit logs for all inference requests. Data residency: US only for now (marketing data).
Timeline & recent activity:
- 2025-09-18: Intro + kickoff call (ff_2025-09-18_emberlake_kickoff). Covered topology, routing rules, expected traffic patterns.
- 2025-09-25: Redwood sent perf questionnaire and sample traffic histogram (owner: Maya). EmberLake shared replay dataset (anonymized) and cost targets.

- 2025-10-02: Benchmark review meeting — Redwood ran initial hosted tests; results show good median but p95 unacceptable on single-threaded configuration (ff_2025-10-02_benchmark-review). SE recommended dedicated GPU pool + batching window tweaks.

- 2025-10-07: Security questionnaire submitted; EmberLake requested KMS/HSM confirmation and retention controls (drive:/security/emberlake-security-faq.pdf). Jira ticket SEC-847 opened for compliance clarifications.
POC milestones (agreed):
- POC Stage 1 (hosted): run 48-hour synthetic replay to validate p50/p95/p99 and token cost delta for batching windows (expected by 2025-10-18).

- POC Stage 2 (dedicated/VPC): deploy dedicated pool in customer VPC or equivalent private deployment to measure end-to-end latency with routing policies and KV cache enabled (target week of 2025-10-20).
- POC Stage 3 (quantization): validate 4-bit/8-bit quantized model variants for reranking model — measure quality delta on held-out prompt set and unit cost improvement.

Notes from SE (Liam): initial recommendations: 1) continuous batching (3-5ms window) for non-urgent rerank ops, 2) aggressive KV prefix caching for repeat user contexts to avoid re-tokenization and save ~30-40% token spend, 3) fallback routing to quantized variant under capacity pressure with quality monitors enabled.
